components.name: Public Primary Button
components.description: Blueprint-blue public action used inside saturated narrative fields.
components.css: .ds-public-primary { min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid #174ea6; border-radius: 0; background: #174ea6; color: #f9fbfc; font: 800 0.75rem/1.2 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-public-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-public-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-public-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #174ea6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Configurator Primary Button
components.description: Blueprint-blue decision action for continuing or submitting the brief.
components.css: .ds-config-primary { min-height: 50px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #101923; border-radius: 0; background: #174ea6; color: #f9fbfc; font: 800 0.78rem/1.2 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-config-primary:hover { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-config-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-config-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #174ea6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Transparent secondary action with the system's square ruled construction.
components.css: .ds-line-button { min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid #101923; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #101923; font: 800 0.75rem/1.2 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-line-button:hover { background: #eef2f5; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-line-button:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-line-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #174ea6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Baseline Input
components.description: Transparent form field registered by a single structural baseline.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">NOMBRE DE LA EMPRESA<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Ej: Comercio Norte"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 10px; color: #101923; font: 800 0.78rem/1.2 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-input { min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #101923; border-radius: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #101923; caret-color: #174ea6; font: 400 1rem/1.55 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { background: rgba(16, 25, 35, 0.035); } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: #174ea6; background: #eef2f5; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #174ea6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: Binary selection marker; technical blue tint means the value is registered.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #101923; border-radius: 0; background: #dce8f7; color: #101923; font: 700 0.85rem/1.2 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-chip span { color: #0f6f7a; font-weight: 900; } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #174ea6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Editorial Navigation Action
components.description: Compact blueprint-blue navigation action that opens the project configurator.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #101923; background: #eef2f5; color: #101923; } .ds-nav strong { font: 800 1.45rem/1 "Franklin Gothic Medium", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-nav strong span { color: #174ea6; } .ds-nav button { padding: 13px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #174ea6; color: #f9fbfc; font: 800 0.76rem/1.2 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #174ea6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Registration Progress
components.description: Configurator state rail showing complete, current, and future layers.
components.css: .ds-progress { padding: 24px 32px 20px; background: #101923; color: #f9fbfc; font: 800 0.68rem/1.4 "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-progress-line { height: 3px; background: rgba(249, 251, 252, 0.22); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-line span { display: block; width: 43%; height: 100%; background: #0f6f7a; } .ds-progress ol { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-progress li { color: #8b99a5; } .ds-progress .done { color: #78c6cc; font-weight: 900; } .ds-progress .done strong { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-progress .current { color: #f9fbfc; } .ds-progress .current strong { text-decoration: underline 2px #8fb7f0; text-underline-offset: 6px; }

narrative.overview: Logotype treats a software proposal as an engineering blueprint in motion: information is registered, aligned, connected, and marked complete. The living release sheet remains the editorial and compositional method, while cool drafting surfaces, blueprint hierarchy, and systems-state color establish the software-engineering identity. The public site is the expressive Persuade surface. It uses architectural typography, full-width color fields, asymmetric composition, and varied editorial pacing to make the academic narrative memorable. The configurator is the calmer Operate expression of the same system: each answer becomes another registered layer of the project brief, while the progress rail and final summary make state explicit.
keyCharacteristics: Frost and drafting-paper reading fields interrupted by committed graphite or blueprint-blue regions.
Oversized compressed uppercase display type paired with a humanist system reading stack.
One-pixel structural rules, square controls, registration axes, nodes, and connectors.
Blueprint blue for hierarchy and action, systems teal for verified states, and technical blue tint for selection.
Purposeful transform-and-opacity motion with reduced-motion handling at the application root.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Blueprint blue means act, focus, or attend; systems teal means verified, live, complete, or successful; technical blue tint means selected or informational. Do not swap those meanings for decoration.

rules.name: The Full-Field Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors may own whole sections or controls. Do not dilute them into scattered ornamental accents.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Display text may be tight and uppercase; body text must remain conventionally spaced and readable. Never apply display compression to paragraphs or form values.

rules.name: The Continuous Sheet Rule
rules.body: Adjacent material should read as one evolving document. Use shared edges, rules, and field changes instead of isolated floating panels.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient card shadows. A shadow is reserved for a live/status point or a control that must remain visibly above the document.

dos: Do make color carry state or own a full region.
Do connect related information with one-pixel rules, shared edges, registration marks, and deliberate alignment.
Do vary public section density while keeping the same palette, typography, and line language.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable contrast, reduced motion, and Spanish voseo across both surfaces.
Do keep the public site- system and configurator cfg- system scoped away from protected panel styles.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, decorative blur, stock imagery, or generic icon tiles.
Don't build the page from repeated equal cards or nest cards inside cards.
Don't add rounded SaaS controls or ambient shadows to soften the structural language.
Don't scatter blueprint blue, systems teal, or technical blue tint outside their hierarchy and state roles.
Don't restyle the internal panel through public or configurator selectors.
